title: Managed Database: primary correction credit — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary correction credit uses the following assessment outcome basis. Book the negative of the smaller of remaining overcharge and customer-authorized amount, rounded half-up once to two USD decimals, as both amount and net amount with zero tax amount. The equality requirement ensures the full remaining error is corrected in one entry.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: remaining overcharge and authorized amount are each USD 12.34. Their smaller value is USD 12.34; half-up rounding retains USD 12.34 and its negative is the credit. The net component is negative USD 12.34 and tax is zero.
